title: vendor: github.com/fluent/fluent-logger-golang 1.6.1
body:
Updates the fluent logger library. Namely this fixes a couple places
where the library could panic when closing and writing to channels.

see fluentd PRs/issues: 

- https://github.com/fluent/fluent-logger-golang/pull/93
- https://github.com/fluent/fluent-logger-golang/pull/95
- https://github.com/fluent/fluent-logger-golang/issues/18
- https://github.com/fluent/fluent-logger-golang/pull/68

closes #40829
closes #32567

Signed-off-by: Cam <gh@sparr.email>
